# FluentCI

> FluentCI is an open-source, programmable CI/CD tool for building, testing, and deploying locally or on runners, with reusable WebAssembly plugins and a local Studio UI.

Website: https://fluentci.io
Repository: https://github.com/fluentci-io/fluentci

Define pipelines in TOML or write Wasm plugins with the Rust, ClojureScript,
PureScript, TypeScript, Python, Gleam, Elixir, or ReScript SDK. Wasm contains the
pipeline logic; commands execute on the host using its installed tools and files.
SDK builds require their language toolchains. ClojureScript starters check shared
`.cljc` source with Typed Clojure before compiling to JavaScript and Wasm.

Install the CLI:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://cli.fluentci.io | sh
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
fluentci --version
```

Create and run a ClojureScript pipeline:

```sh
fluentci init --sdk clojurescript
fluentci run main hello
```

Add a module to an existing workspace with
`fluentci modules add ci --sdk purescript`, then run `fluentci run ci hello`.
The root `fluentci.toml` declares modules and steps. Module paths are relative to
that configuration file. Local execution requires no account.

Run `fluentci studio` to manage projects, inspect execution history, follow live
logs, view pipeline spans, and export CI configuration. Studio is available in a
browser and as a desktop app.

## Documentation

- [CLI documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fluentci-io/fluentci/main/README.md): Installation, configuration, workspace modules, commands, Studio, and CI exports.
- [SDK starter templates](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fluentci-io/fluentci/main/templates/README.md): Embedded starter projects and build requirements.
- [ClojureScript starter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fluentci-io/fluentci/main/templates/sdk/clojurescript/README.md): Static checking, compilation, Wasm exports, and local SDK layout.
- [Engine documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fluentci-io/fluentci-engine/main/README.md): Pipeline runtime, host execution, environment providers, and engine usage.
- [Guest SDKs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fluentci-io/fluentci-engine/main/sdk/README.md): Language SDK documentation and examples.

## Optional

- [Registry API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fluentci-io/fluentci/main/apps/api/README.md): Gleam XRPC API, AT Protocol plugin records, SQLite indexing, and publishing storage configuration.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/fluentci-io/fluentci#contributing): Development and contribution guidance.
- [Community](https://discord.gg/H7M28d9dRk): FluentCI Discord.
